answer: Run a registration vault with escalating deposits: the first identity an operator registers locks 1 unit; a second identity sharing the same attestation root locks 4; a third 16, quadrupling each time. As attackers wander through a fog of cheap virtual machines, the vault prices mass production out of reach: a farm minting 100 masks must front 4^99 units, mathematically impossible, while an honest agent enters the meadow once and pays a single unit. The attacker cost explodes exponentially; the honest cost stays flat.
